name: Helseujang-eseo Sal-anamgi
source:
Our protagonist went to the gym through a friend's introduction, and one day his body transformed to be as small as a bug after drinking some suspicious protein drinks from his trainer. Will he be able to survive in the midst of the gigantic muscle giants and get back to normal in the end?

[Translated from [url=https://smallkr.itch.io/gymshrinking]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角经朋友介绍来到健身房。某天，喝下教练给的可疑蛋白饮料后，他的身体竟缩小到了虫子般的大小。他能在一群庞大的肌肉巨人之间活下来，最终恢复原样吗？

[译自[url=https://smallkr.itch.io/gymshrinking]Itch.io[/url]]
